message.content:
I’m sorry I don’t have access to live financial data right now, so I can only offer you an approximation based on recent market trends:

| Currency pair | Approximate rate |
|---------------|------------------|
| USD → GBP     | ~1 $ ≈ £0.78 |

Using this rough figure:

```
$20 × 0.78 ≈ £15.60
```

So roughly **£15–£16** would be what you’d get today if you exchanged $20 into pounds.  

If you need an exact amount, please check your bank’s website, a reliable finance app, or a trusted online converter like XE.com or OANDA – they’ll pull the latest official exchange rate for you.
